scope: Static review of source capture and exact-array join, bounded direct source-field checks, primary XML statements and proposed identity wording. No fitting, full join replay, or audit of historical classifier results.

checks.check: Workbook row selection and IDAT schema
checks.evidence: Direct read-only inspection found exactly 1077 nonempty reference rows and 428 nonempty validation rows. All first-column labels have the selected cohort prefix; no nonempty source records are silently omitted. Every IDAT is already an exact digit-chip_RddCdd basename.
1972 data rows each have 27 columns. Source Name and Characteristics[individual] are nonempty throughout; 986 distinct individual labels. Joined fields have unique column names.

Complete basename regular expression removes only the Grn/Red channel suffix; chip and physical array-position identity are preserved. Code requires exactly two channel rows per array, one of each channel, and consistent individual label. Direct set comparisons implement the stated exact-IDAT overlap estimand.

identity-results.json reports 1077 reference, 428 validation, 1972 SDRF channel rows, 986 arrays and 986 accession-local individual labels; all three exact-array intersections are zero. This review did not rerun the completed intersection calculation.

Read Koelsche primary XML Methods: All samples of the reference and validation set are from individual/different patients. Proposed wording explicitly preserves this author assertion while stating the limits of an independent public patient-key audit.

Read Lyskjær primary XML Methods/Results: 986 deposited/uploaded profiles, three tumor profiles excluded for QC, and 983 in the performance analysis. Findings preserve this distinction; 986 is used for metadata identities only.

Proposed correction does not infer different patients across studies from distinct array IDs or accession-local labels. It explicitly leaves different-array specimens from a shared patient unexcluded.

nonblocking_observations.detail: Raw SDRF has Protocol REF five times and Term Source REF twice. csv.DictReader collapses these repeated names, so emtab_fields is not a lossless representation of all 27 header positions. None is used for identity joins. Optional wording: identity-results.json records available distinct field names; retain raw SDRF as the complete schema.

limits: 118 retained fusion-compatible profiles and three discordances are explicitly inherited frozen evidence, not checked here.
No patient-level independence across studies is independently established.
No methylation measurements, predictions, classifier fitting, or diagnostic adjudication were reanalyzed.
Source files were inspected from captured private evidence; no fresh network retrieval was performed for this review.
recommended_disposition: Integrate the scoped source correction and metadata receipt. Preserve the author-reported patient statement, the array-only scope, and 986 deposited versus 983 analyzed distinction. No blocking code or scientific wording change required.
